name: Maelstrom (Su)
source: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds
book: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds

facets.bk: The Book of Many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds

body:
When the shaman hits a creature with a weapon enhanced by an elemental weapon property, the shaman deals damage equal to the weapon property’s damage to each enemy adjacent to that target.
